subject: prd/abandoned-feature-retirement
statement: If If abandonment lacks explicit human authority, an owning feature drive is active, cancellation is pending, an attempt is not quiesced, ownership or routing remains assigned, the feature remains resumable, or legacy-equivalent terminal evidence is absent, then the system shall Preserve the surface and refuse destructive transition
intent: lifecycle predicate and exact terminal transition required
fit_criterion: Missing, inferred, agent-only, active, cancellation-pending, non-quiesced, routed, cancelled-but-resumable, stale, malformed, conflicting, and legacy-without-equivalent fixtures all refuse
